propositions: Eight empty, uncommitted, untracked directories exist in .tickets-tracker, each flagged as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH by fsck, indicating incomplete ticket writes interrupted before the first event was committed.
All eight directories pass five safety guards (empty, uncommitted, no rebar-tracked ticket, no open file handles, mtime >30 min old) and are debris from process interruption, not active writer state.
rebar tracker-maintenance --clean with per-directory triage and all-or-nothing run-level equality gate successfully removed all eight directories, reducing fsck findings from 16 to 7.
Tracker HEAD remained byte-identical before and after cleanup, confirming no committed ticket data was modified; only untracked working-tree residue was cleared.
